questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A.They made fruit mash for me.

B. They extracted 30 worms from my wounds on my legs and arms.

C. But I was unable to eat.

D. They washed me with salt water and bandaged my wounds after putting a lotion on them.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'BDAC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence** 'B'** is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about **'worm extraction from the wound'**. Hence** B** is the** first sentence**.
 
• The phrase** 'putting a lotion on them**' in sentence **D** is directly linked to the** 'wounds on my legs and arms'** in sentence **B**. Hence **D follows sentence B.**
 
• Between sentence **A** and sentence** C**, it is understandable that *one incident happened after the other *and we can understand that sentence **C will always follow **sentence **A **because **first the 'fruit mash'** **needs to be given only then he can refuse or realize that he was 'unable to eat'.**
 
• Hence sentence **A** **follows** **D** and sentence **C follows A.**

**Paragraph after rearrangement:** *They extracted 30 worms from my wounds on my legs and arms. They washed me with salt water and bandaged my wounds after putting a lotion on them. They made fruit mash for me. But I was unable to eat.*

questions.question:
Examine the four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. Some Europeans demand that Europe slam its gates.

B. Today more and more humans are crossing more and more borders in search of a job.

C. Nowhere is it more apparent than in Europe.

D. But others call for opening the gates wider.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'BCAD'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **'B'** is **independent **of any other sentence as it is giving general information about humans crossing borders in search of jobs. Hence, **B is the first sentence.**
 
• The phrase **'Nowhere it is more apparent' **in sentence **C** is directly linked with **'crossing borders' **mentioned in sentence** B**, hence **C follows B.**
 
• The noun** 'European' **in sentence **A** is directly linked to **'Europe'** mentioned in sentence **C**, hence** A follows C.**
 
• The *pronoun*** 'others' **in sentence** D** refers back to the** 'Europeans' **mentioned in sentence **A**, hence **D** becomes the **concluding sentence of the paragraph.**
